title: Apple TV’s ‘Guilty Creatures’ Series Adds Brian d’Arcy James, Reed Birney, Gus Birney (EXCLUSIVE)
description:
The upcoming Apple TV series “Guilty Creatures” has added three recurring guest stars, Variety has learned exclusively. 

	Brian d’Arcy James (“The
body:
The upcoming Apple TV series “Guilty Creatures” has added three recurring guest stars, Variety has learned exclusively. 

	Brian d’Arcy James (“The Copenhagen Test,” “Rabbit Rabbit”), Reed Birney (“Blue Film,” “Silo”), and Gus Birney (“Shining Vale,” “Black Rabbit”) are all set to appear in the series, which is based on the Mikita Brottman true crime book “Guilty Creatures: Sex, God, and Murder in Tallahassee, Florida.” 
	

	As previously announced, Julia Garner will star in the series along with Lewis Pullman, Maddie Hasson, Mary-Louise Parker, and Gabriel Basso. The logline for the show states that it “delves into the psyche of a torrid romance and subsequent act of murder between two young, adulterous but God-fearing lovers, unraveling their complex lives and the emotional toll of living as killers for 18 years.”

	James is repped by Gersh and Thruline. Reed Birney is repped by Paradigm and Suskin/Karshan Management. Gus Birney is repped by CESD and Suskin/Karshan Management

	Tomorrow Studios, an ITV Studios partner, developed the project and brought it to Apple. Craig Gillespie is attached to direct and executive produce under his Fortunate Jack Productions banner. Sarah DeLappe (“Bodies Bodies Bodies,” “The Regime”) will write and executive produce. 

	Stuart Zicherman will serve as showrunner and executive producer. Garner will executive produce through Alma Margo in addition to starring. Marty Adelstein, Becky Clements and Alissa Bachner will executive produce for Tomorrow Studios along with Annie Marter of Fortunate Jack and Brottman. Stephanie Laing will serve as executive producer and direct. Both Fortunate Jack and Alma Margo are under first-look deals with Tomorrow Studios.

schema.headline: Apple TV’s ‘Guilty Creatures’ Series Adds Brian d’Arcy James, Reed Birney, Gus Birney (EXCLUSIVE)

title: Anime Licensing Platform AniBiz Gets $6 Million Investment From Japan’s TBS Group, Toei Animation and TV Tokyo Holdings
description: Nakama, the start-up behind anime licensing platform AniBiz.com, has raised an initial $6 million in funding from three of Japan’s top anime licens
body:
Nakama, the start-up behind anime licensing platform AniBiz.com, has raised an initial $6 million in funding from three of Japan’s top anime licensors: TBS Group, Toei Animation and TV Tokyo Holdings.

	AniBiz was launched in July by Crunchyroll founder Kun Gao along with former Crunchyroll execs Brady McCollum and Sae Whan Song. 

	The site now hosts more than 30 anime licensors, up from 20 at launch. Newly joined rights holders include ABC Animation, DMM.com, docomo Anime Store, Genco, GREE Entertainment, Shochiku, ShoPro, Sola Entertainment and more. They join launch partners such as ADK Emotions, Avex Pictures, CyberAgent, Dentsu Anime Solutions, DNP, FCC, Furyu Pictures, Hakuhodo DY MAP, Imagica, MBS, Pony Canyon, TAKARATOMY, TOHO Global, TV Asahi, YTE and others.
	

	Nakama says AniBiz is the first dedicated business-to-business marketplace built for the global anime industry. The platform provides a centralized and secure environment for global buyers to access anime IP and connect with anime rights holders.

	“When the companies that create and license anime’s biggest IP invest in a platform, it says this is where the industry does business,” Brady McCollum, co-founder and CEO of Nakama, said in a statement. “This investment further solidifies AniBiz.com as the official gateway for global anime licensing and collaboration.”

	“Toei Animation has spent nearly 70 years building characters that are loved around the world,” said Masayuki Endo, senior executive officer and deputy head of sales and planning headquarter of Toei Animation Co. Ltd. “Protecting that IP while opening it to new partners requires the right infrastructure. We believe AniBiz is that infrastructure, and we are investing to help it become the industry standard.”
	

	TV Tokyo Holdings senior managing director Toshiyuki Hiraoka commented, “This partnership will maximize the global value of anime IP and expand our licensee network across markets worldwide.”

	AniBiz is open to any company interested in licensing anime and “no existing anime industry relationships are needed,” according to Nakana.

	“Access to anime IP should not depend on who you know,” said Sae Whan Song, co-founderand head of business development at Nakana. “With the industry’s leading licensors on one platform,every company in the world now has an official way in. The only question is which IP to licensefirst.”

schema.headline: Anime Licensing Platform AniBiz Gets $6 Million Investment From Japan’s TBS Group, Toei Animation and TV Tokyo Holdings

title: Lego Appoints Its First Head of Celebrity Talent and Brand First Partnerships
description:
The Lego Group has appointed its first head of celebrity talent and brand first partnerships.

	Kelsey Gray Sherman has joined the company in the H
body:
The Lego Group has appointed its first head of celebrity talent and brand first partnerships.

	Kelsey Gray Sherman has joined the company in the Hollywood whisperer role, which is part of the Entertainment, Partnerships & Content division. The new position “reflects the company’s growing focus on expanding the Lego brand’s presence across entertainment and culture,” according to a press release. Sherman will shape the toy and media company’s approach to celebrity talent, identifying and building relationships with entertainers and brands in ways that go beyond traditional licensing and product collaborations.
	

	Sherman, who comes to Lego from WME, where she served as the vice president of the Entertainment Marketing & Advisory group, will be based in Los Angeles. She will report directly to Jill Wilfert, Lego’s senior vice president of Entertainment, Partnerships & Content, and will serve as a member of the division’s leadership team.

	“Kelsey brings deep relationships across the talent and entertainment communities, along with a strong understanding of the Lego brand,” said Wilfert. “She knows how to bring together the right talent, partners and ideas in ways that feel fresh and authentic, and her experience and instincts will be invaluable as we continue to grow our work in entertainment and culture.”

	Sherman added, “Having worked closely with the Lego Group for many years, I’ve seen first-hand its unique ability to bring together entertainment, experiences and culture. I’m excited to build on that strength through ambitious, distinctive partnerships with exceptional talent and brands. Together, we can create new ways to inspire creativity and play and connect with audiences around the world.”
	

	Lego has built a large presence in the entertainment industry and cultural zeitgeist, with partnerships that date back decades. The company’s collaboration with the “Star Wars” franchise, for example, includes toy sets, television projects and a popular video game. The flagship Lego movies are considered big successes, and the company even partnered with Pharrell Williams in 2024 to create a biopic animated entirely with Lego bricks.

schema.headline: Lego Appoints Its First Head of Celebrity Talent and Brand First Partnerships

title: This Company Is Paying One Lucky ‘GTA 6’ Fan Nearly $900 to Play the Game for 8 Hours
description:
Is it a gamer’s dream job of the year?

	Ahead of the release “Grand Theft Auto 6” in November, TV and broadband provider Virgin Media has launched
body:
Is it a gamer’s dream job of the year?

	Ahead of the release “Grand Theft Auto 6” in November, TV and broadband provider Virgin Media has launched a new sweepstakes: It’s going to pay one winning candidate almost $900 to play the hotly anticipated adventure-action title for eight hours and share their “honest” review of the game on social media. The winner also will get a free copy of “GTA 6.”


	Virgin Media is accepting applications through Nov. 15 for the gig, requiring applicants to explain why they deserve to get the job. The winner will be paid €100 (approximately $111) per hour to play the game for eight hours, which can be nonconsecutive. The company is encouraging job hopefuls to “explore the sun-soaked state of Leonida, cruise the neon-lit streets of Vice City, and answer the question on everyone’s mind. Does ‘GTA 6’ live up to the hype?”
	

	The catch? The promotion is being sponsored by Virgin Media Ireland, and the offer is open only to residents of the Republic of Ireland. The company is hoping to get a publicity boost from the stunt: The winner will be required to share their “GTA 6” review on Instagram or TikTok and tag Virgin Media Ireland.

	“‘GTA 6’ is the biggest game launch in years, maybe ever,” a Virgin Media spokesperson said. “It’s the kind of launch that friends plan their whole week around, and we wanted to be part of that excitement.” Virgin Media is a division of Liberty Global, John Malone’s international telecommunications and investment company.

	Other efforts to piggyback on “GTA 6” hype: An infantry division of the U.S. Army has offered active-duty soldiers a four-day pass to play the game if they reenlist for a minimum of two years.
	

	Take-Two Interactive’s Rockstar Games will release “GTA 6,” set in the Florida-like fictional world of Leonida, for Sony’s PS5 and Microsoft’s Xbox Series X and S on Nov. 19. The game’s first trailer has racked up more than 300 million views on YouTube, and Rockstar’s extended look at the game drew more than 31 million views on Netflix from Aug. 27-31.

schema.headline: This Company Is Paying One Lucky ‘GTA 6’ Fan Nearly $900 to Play the Game for 8 Hours

title: BAFTA Names Hilary Rosen as Chair
description:
BAFTA has confirmed that Hilary Rosen has been appointed as its new chair.

	Following a year as deputy chair, Rosen succeeds Sara Putt, who steps
body:
BAFTA has confirmed that Hilary Rosen has been appointed as its new chair.

	Following a year as deputy chair, Rosen succeeds Sara Putt, who steps down after a three-year term.

	Rosen will oversee the organization’s “mission to champion film, games and television talent through its awards, industry leadership and year-round development programs,” BAFTA said. 


	A BAFTA television committee member since 2021 and later its chair, she helped shape the TV and Craft Awards and oversee their juries. Outside BAFTA, Rosen is director of commissioning at UKTV, leading its slate of original scripted and unscripted content.
	

	Rosen will be supported by Ade Rawcliffe and Andrew Miller as deputy chairs of the academy. They will serve a two-year term.

	After an election, the following folks have been appointed to the board of trustees: Charu Desdot and Caroline Levy are the chairs for BAFTA’s games and television committees, while Nahrein Kemp will take up the role of LIT committee chair.

	Additionally, Shrina Shah, chair of the governance and appointments committee, will join the BAFTA board of trustees.

	Desdot, who takes over from Tara Saunders as chair of the games committee, is a studio director with over 25 years’ industry experience; her work spans some of the biggest names in games, including Sony and Xbox. She also has extensive BAFTA experience as a BAFTA Breakthrough recipient in 2014 and later serving on games award juries.

	Levy, who will take over as chair of the television committee, is an experienced scripted producer, working across the BBC, Paramount and several independent production companies. Alongside production, she has a “strong record of accomplishment in bringing people together to address industry challenges,” BAFTA said, including acting as creative lead for International Horizons Scripted, a training program to encourage international growth for independent production companies in Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland.
	

	Kemp becomes chair of the LIT committee. As ITV’s DEI and talent lead, she works with commissioners and producers to deliver its DEI strategy and £80 million Diversity Commissioning Fund and leads its £1 million Diversity Development Fund. Her experience includes the BAFTA Review 2020, BAFTA’s LIT committee and the Mayor of London’s Skills for Londoners Business Board. She is a non-executive director of Creative Access and a recipient of the Women in Film and TV Achievement of the Year Award.

	Rosen said, “I have long been passionate about everything BAFTA does to promote the screen arts and champion talent across the screen industries, so it is a great privilege to take on the role of BAFTA chair. I am delighted to be able to do this alongside our newly appointed committee chairs, Charu, Caroline and Nahrein and the rest of the BAFTA board of trustees. All are outstanding industry leaders and with the collective passion and insight we share I’m confident that this board of trustees will continue to build on the important and impactful work that has gone before.”

schema.headline: BAFTA Names Hilary Rosen as Chair

title: Danielle Harris Documentary Set About Her Career as a Child Star, ‘Halloween’ Scream Queen (EXCLUSIVE)
description:
Deranged Minds Entertainment has announced a feature-length doc on an iconic scream queen.

	Danielle Harris, the actress who was in four “Hallowee
body:
Deranged Minds Entertainment has announced a feature-length doc on an iconic scream queen.

	Danielle Harris, the actress who was in four “Halloween” films and many more projects, is the subject of a new film about her life and career shot over the last three years. 

	Per the official description, “Before she was old enough to drive, Danielle Harris had outrun Michael Myers twice and held her own opposite Bruce Willis and Roseanne Barr. Off screen, she survived far worse: her father’s death in an unsolved car accident, the suicides of a famous partner and a close friend, a stalker who tracked her for two decades and a pregnancy complication that stopped her heart.”
	

	The documentary includes archival footage, private home video and interviews with Harris, her family, friends and collaborators.

	“People think they know Danielle because they grew up watching her,” director and producer Destinie Orndoff said in a statement. “They’ve seen the performances. They’ve never seen what it cost her, and Danielle didn’t hold anything back.” 

	Some of Harris’ film credits include 1988’s “Halloween 4: The Return of Michael Myers,” 1989’s “Halloween 5: The Revenge of Michael Myers,” 1991’s “Don’t Tell Mom the Babysitter’s Dead,” 2007’s “Halloween” and 2009’s “Halloween II.” She also appeared on TV in shows like “Roseanne” and “The Wild Thornberrys.”

	“In the three years of filming, I had the honor of getting to know the woman off the screen,” director and producer Tristan Clay said in a statement. “I can’t wait for audiences to see this side of her.”
	

	The documentary is currently in post-production, with a festival run planned for 2027. It is produced by Orndoff, Clay, Hayden Todd Wilberger and Jordan Wyant. Distribution inquiries can be sent to derangedmindsentertainment@yahoo.com.

	Watch a trailer for the documentary below.

schema.headline: Danielle Harris Documentary Set About Her Career as a Child Star, ‘Halloween’ Scream Queen (EXCLUSIVE)

title: Russell Brand Trial: Judge Drops Indecent Assault Charge, Replaces It With Attempted Assault Count
description: A judge overseeing Russell Brand’s criminal trial has dismissed an indecent assault charge against the British comedian and actor, replacing it wit
body:
A judge overseeing Russell Brand’s criminal trial has dismissed an indecent assault charge against the British comedian and actor, replacing it with a count of attempted indecent assault.

	Mr Justice Bennathan made the decision midway through the trial, telling jurors that he had concluded there was “insufficient evidence” to support the indecent assault charge in connection with an alleged incident involving a female MTV employee in 2001, according to Sky News.
	

	The allegation relates to an incident in which Brand allegedly grabbed the woman by the arm and tried to drag her into a toilet.

	The judge subsequently added a charge of attempted indecent assault to the indictment, relating to the same alleged incident. While Brand has been formally acquitted of the original indecent assault count, jurors will still be asked to consider whether he attempted to commit the alleged offense. To formalize the decision, the judge selected one juror to deliver a not-guilty verdict on the original charge.

	Describing the procedure as a “slightly artificial process,” Bennathan told the jury, “The defendant Russell Brand has entered a not-guilty plea to this count.”

	The development came after the court heard four police statements given by Brand.

	Brand, 51, who rose to fame as a stand-up comedian and television presenter before launching a Hollywood career with films including “Forgetting Sarah Marshall” and “Get Him to the Greek,” has denied all allegations of wrongdoing.

	The trial at London’s Southwark Crown Court centers on allegations made by six women concerning incidents dating from 1999 to 2009. Brand originally faced seven charges, including three counts of rape, three of sexual assault and one of indecent assault.
	

	The proceedings have featured testimony from several women who have accused Brand of sexual misconduct. Last week, a fourth accuser told the court that Brand had sexually assaulted her while she was working at a radio station in 2004 or 2005. She alleged that he pushed her against a wall, forcibly kissed her and touched her breasts and buttocks while people accompanying him looked on without intervening.

	During the prosecution’s opening arguments, Riel Karmy-Jones KC described Brand as “ruthless and calculated,” alleging that his sexual appetite was “indiscriminate and voracious.” Prosecutors have argued that the six women, who did not know one another, came forward independently.

	The criminal investigation followed a joint investigation by The Sunday Times and Channel 4’s “Dispatches” in September 2023, which brought allegations of rape, sexual assault and emotional abuse against Brand into the public eye.

	Brand has pleaded not guilty to all seven charges against him.

schema.headline: Russell Brand Trial: Judge Drops Indecent Assault Charge, Replaces It With Attempted Assault Count

title: Lisa Rinna, Phaedra Parks, Dolores Catania and More ‘Real Housewives’ to Star in Revival of Neil Simon’s ‘Rumors’
description: Lisa Rinna, Phaedra Parks and Dolores Catania are among the Bravo’s “Real Housewives” stars who are uniting for a new Off-Broadway revival of Neil
body:
Lisa Rinna, Phaedra Parks and Dolores Catania are among the Bravo’s “Real Housewives” stars who are uniting for a new Off-Broadway revival of Neil Simon’s farce “Rumors.”

	They will be joined by Stacey Rusch, Cynthia Bailey, Eileen Davidson, Carole Radziwill and Candiace Dillard-Bassett. This production will mark the New York stage debut for everyone other than Rinna, who has appeared on Broadway in “Chicago” as Roxie Hart and the upcoming “It’s a Wonderful Life” revival.
	

	Written by Simon, the acclaimed playwright of “The Odd Couple,” Sweet Charity,” Promises, Promises” and dozens of others, “Rumors” revolves around a swanky soirée that spirals out of control. Here’s the official logline: “Reality was just rehearsal. When four couples gather for a party in a wealthy New York suburb, they expect champagne, revelry, and a night of good fun. Instead, they find their host in an alarming state, his wife missing, and the police on their way. Talk about a dinner party from hell!” Christine Baranski, Jessica Walter, Joyce Van Patten and Lisa Banes led the original production, which opened on Broadway in November 1988.

	The revival, which will have a limited run at the Newman Mills Theater at the Robert W. Wilson MCC Theater Space, will be directed by Zhailon Levingston, a recent Tony Award winner for “Cats: The Jellicle Ball.” Performances will begin on Jan. 9 ahead of opening night on Jan. 25, 2027.

	The production will feature two separate casts including Rinna as ‘Chris,’ Parks as ‘Claire,’ Rusch as ‘Cookie,’ and Catania as ‘Cassie’ from Jan. 9 through Feb. 28, followed by Bailey as ‘Chris,’ Davidson as ‘Claire,’ Radziwill as ‘Cookie,’ and Dillard-Bassett as ‘Cassie’ from March 2 through April 21. Casting for their husbands will be announced at a later date.
	

	“I first experienced ‘Rumors’ as a child, and I can still remember the overwhelming sound of laughter filling the theater. That feeling of collective joy and release has stayed with me ever since,” Levingston said in a statement. “To me, Neil Simon’s comedy is a masterclass in the architecture of laughter, and I’ve long been baffled that this extraordinary play hasn’t received a major revival in recent years.”

	Levingston adds he’s excited to tell the story through the lens of “The Real Housewives” to show “how naturally these two worlds collide.” 

	“Without changing a single word of Simon’s brilliant text, we can reveal something new in the piece: The delicious chaos that unfolds when private lives become public spectacle. At a time when we are so deeply divided, I can think of few things more necessary than gathering in a theater to laugh together,” he said. “My hope is to introduce a new generation to the same exhilarating feeling I experienced as a child, while reminding longtime lovers of Neil Simon just how timeless, audacious, and wildly funny his work remains.”

schema.headline: Lisa Rinna, Phaedra Parks, Dolores Catania and More ‘Real Housewives’ to Star in Revival of Neil Simon’s ‘Rumors’

	“All of a Sudden,” “Clarissa,” “La Gradiva,” “The Invite” and “Tender Loving Care” lead the nominations for the 36th edition of The Gothams with four nods each.

	The Gotham Film & Media Institute announced nominations for the 36th edition of The Gothams, singling out 42 feature films and 25 performances in 11 award categories. “Clarissa” and “The Invite” were also nominated for best feature, alongside “Club Kid,” “The Debut,” “Dreams in Nightmares,” “Josephine,” “Mouse,” “Paper Tiger,” “Primetime,” “Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma” and “Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother.”

title: ’40 Watts From Nowhere’: How a Feisty Pirate Radio Station Stormed the Airwaves in 1990s Silver Lake With Help From the Red Hot Chili Peppers and More

body:
The 1990s were a very different time — especially in Silver Lake, California — once a fertile neighborhood of artists and musicians and now a pricey hot spot. Three decades ago, the indie music scene was flourishing with homegrown acts like Beck and Rilo Kiley, based around clubs like Spaceland and the Garage.

	And for more than two heady years, music lovers within a mile or two of the Sunset Junction area could groove to the wildly eclectic sounds of KBLT, a pirate radio station that operated from 1995 to 1998.
	

	The mystique of the scrappy station is told in the new documentary “40 Watts From Nowhere,” a fond look back at the Silver Lake music scene and the bands and personalities that came through KBLT. The doc premiered at Slamdance in February and, thanks to Jack Black stepping in as executive producer, it got the attention of Amazon Prime, where begins streaming Tuesday.

	KBLT was the brainchild of Sue Carpenter, a journalist and music lover who learned about a “legal bubble” that enabled people to start low-power radio stations without prohibitively expensive FCC licenses. Carpenter learned how to put such a station together from Berkeley, California pirate radio guru Stephen Dunifer, got help building a transmitter, and started her first radio project, KPBJ, in her San Francisco apartment. After moving to L.A., Carpenter (using a pseudonym) selected another food-themed acronym and started making connections to line up DJs.

	Opening with shots of Silver Lake’s iconic Walking Man and Happy Foot Sad Foot sign, the documentary is packed with vintage footage of the station and its DJs, from the Red Hot Chili Peppers to DJs Mike Watt of the Minutemen, Don Bolles of the Germs and Keith Morris of the Circle Jerks. Also featured are scenes of mid-90s Silver Lake and contemporary interviews with Tom Morello and others who got started around the time.
	

	“What is the answer to corporate ownership of the media?” Morello asks in the film. “Get rid of it. Let’s start over.”

	Where did all this nostalgic footage come from? Years after the station shut down, Carpenter was amazed to find out that one of the station’s DJs had boxes of videos of the station in a box in his garage.

	“I would never have made this documentary if this video hadn’t existed,” says Carpenter. “Even though there was a sit-down interview with me, and I was shooting some of this video, I have no recollection of ever having done that.” Robert Sullivan, known as Sully from the band Possum Dixon, was shooting the footage for a documentary he never made. After Carpenter wrote a book about KBLT, “Sully just sort of sort of piped up,” says Carpenter. He said, “You know, I have all these videos. They’re just in a box in my garage. I’m about to throw them out. Do you want them?

	“I went through the video and was shocked that he pretty much had the whole arc of the story, and that made me feel like I could make a documentary out of it,” she says.

	Carpenter had no special background in radio or music before deciding to start the station. “I just wanted to do it,” she says. “Naïveté has been my superpower, and not knowing what it takes — if I had known, I would not have done it,” she says. “You get to a certain point, and there’s another hurdle, and you just have to cross it, and then you get on air, and then it just feels magical.”

	After the transmitter was up and running, a 24/7 schedule came together with help from Brandon Jay, the drummer of Silver Lake’s Lutefisk, who became a co-producer on “40 Watts.” The station didn’t just play indie rock — Carpenter’s show was dedicated to French pop, while other DJs spun the blues, jazz, prog rock, punk, funk and techno.



	

					Thurston Moore of Sonic Youth visits KBLT with DJ and musician Mike Watt.
									lynda macareno
	



	“You didn’t know who would be playing what, and if you turned it on the radio, you didn’t know what you would be hearing, or who would be talking,” says “40 Watts” music supervisor Mara Kuge

	It was a time when hearing something out of the mainstream on the radio could pretty much blow your mind, Kuge recalls. 

	“I don’t even know if people understand the wow factor of hearing something like that back then and knowing, ‘OK, there’s somebody else who listens to the same pretty obscure at the time music that I do, and who is this person, and how can I find it?’” Kuge says.
	

	“It was basically Sue and her cat living in a one-bedroom apartment in Silver Lake with a parade of people she didn’t know, including strange men,” Kuge explains. Carpenter attributes her open-door policy to being a “curious person” with “no boundaries,” though it did result in cleaning up a lot of beer bottles. “It’s not like everyone was a total fucking slob, but there were enough who were when you get that many people together,” she remembers.

	The station’s mystique grew when some of the hottest bands of the time dropped by to play live sets, including the Red Hot Chili Peppers, who squeezed into the hallway to play.

	The doc’s soundtrack includes dozens of bands the station frequently played, including Bikini Kill, Rage Against the Machine, Elliott Smith, Mudhoney, and Fugazi, who rarely license their music.

	Less than three years later, it all came crashing down when Berkeley’s Dunifer lost his case and FCC officials moved quickly to shut down KBLT.

	Carpenter, who went on to become a motorcycle columnist for the L.A. Times and then a radio and TV journalist, is surprised there hasn’t been more content about the distinctive sounds of that time.

	“Honestly, I thought that people would have given it more documentation by now,” she says. “Our scene was really, really creative and colorful.”

	Carpenter says today’s Silver Lake, with its corporate boutiques and private-equity restaurants, feels foreign to her. “I feel like I don’t relate to the neighborhood anymore, because it’s become so commercial. The mom-and-popness of it, the heart of it, doesn’t feel like it’s there anymore.”

	As DJ and Thelonious Monster musician Bob Forrest says in the doc, “Silver Lake was magical. KBLT was this beautiful cherry on top of this beautiful time in Los Angeles.”

schema.headline: ’40 Watts From Nowhere’: How a Feisty Pirate Radio Station Stormed the Airwaves in 1990s Silver Lake With Help From the Red Hot Chili Peppers and More

            Savannah Chrisley is spilling the details on her new romance ... including her fiancé’s name and how their love story began!!!
      
    
            The reality star opened up about her relationship on her podcast, “Unlocked,” revealing she met her man, Jason, in political circles while she was still fighting to get pardons for her formerly incarcerated parents.
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                                  
      
    
            Savannah said she first spotted him and thought he was “just gorgeous,” but things didn’t immediately take off between them ... until Jason eventually reached out to her on June 1, 2025, sending a text praising her efforts for her family, saying, "Hey, Savannah, it's just incredible what you did for your family. You never stopped. Fearless person. Congratulations."
      

            The reality TV star adds she didn’t see the message right away and didn't respond back until June 10 ... but once she did, the two started texting back and forth, kicking off their romance.
      
    
      
        
              
    
    
            The couple have been together since last July, according to Savannah, and have already traveled all over the world together, with stops including New York, California, Florida and Chicago ... as well as international destinations like the Cayman Islands, London, Switzerland, Italy, Turkey and Greece.
      
    
            Savannah also gushed about how Jason has changed her life, saying he has never raised his voice at her and makes her feel secure in their relationship -- praising him for never feeling threatened by her or the opportunities that come with her career.
      
    
        Waiting for your permission to load the Instagram Media.
      
    
            As we previously reported ... the “Chrisley Knows Best” alum revealed her pregnancy and engagement Tuesday morning, with a wholesome video documenting her pregnancy journey so far and named her mystery man as just "J."
      
    
            Now, Savannah is ready to open up about details of their quiet relationship, as the couple begins a brand new chapter in their life and gears up to be parents!

body:
Ex-NBA Star Paul Pierce
                          Says He's 'Drowning Financially,' Struggling to Pay Bills ...
                          After Losing Fox Sports Gig
                      
                  
                                                                        Published 
                              October 27, 2026
                            1:00 AM PDT
                                                                      |
                                                                Updated 
                                  October 27, 2026
                                8:47 AM PDT
                                    
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                  
      
    
            Paul Pierce claims he is "tapped out" financially while trying to keep up with his court-ordered support payments ... due to him no longer receiving income from Fox Sports ... TMZ has learned.
      
    
            According to court docs, obtained by TMZ, Paul claims his last check from Fox Sports came in August. He said his average monthly income was $119K, but now it is zero. He said he earned around $23K last month from his partnership interests in other business ventures.
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                  
      
    
            Paul said he pays around $28K in child support and another $20K in spousal support per month … but claims he only has $300K in the bank and $3 million in property.
      

            He says he spends around $48K a month in bills, including $8K in childcare, $5K in groceries, $7K on eating out, $3,200 on utilities, $1K on clothes, $3,500 on entertainment, and various other expenses.
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                  
      
    
            Paul is asking the court to shut down his ex-wife Princess Santiago’s request for $40K in legal fees and another $10K for a forensic accountant. She claimed Paul was playing games about his financial records ... and wanted an expert to review his finances.
      
    
            In his filing, Paul's attorney said Paul would have "great difficulty" paying these fees since his Fox Sports contract was terminated ... adding that he was "drowning financially" and having trouble keeping up with the monetary obligations
      
    
            Princess’ request for additional funds came after Paul was ordered to pay Princess $8,508 per month in temporary child support for their son, King. He was also ordered to pay $100K in legal fees.
      
    
            Paul reportedly earned around $200 million during his NBA career.

title: LSU Student Allegedly Raped at Gun Point in Freshman Dorm: Report

Louisiana State University
                          Student Allegedly Raped at Gunpoint in Dorm
body:
Louisiana State University
                          Student Allegedly Raped at Gunpoint in Dorm
                      
                  
                                                                        Published 
                              October 27, 2026
                            8:10 AM PDT
                                                                            
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                                  
      
    
            A Louisiana State University freshman was allegedly raped at gunpoint in an on-campus dormitory ... according to a report citing university police.
      
    
            According to the New York Post -- citing an arrest warrant -- 21-year-old Ronald White was arrested and booked on felony rape and firearm charges.
      
    
            The Post states cops received a call about an alleged rape that occurred at Spruce Hall ... an on-campus dormitory on the campus in Baton Rouge, LA.
      

            Officers say the alleged victim told them she went to Spruce Hall earlier in the evening on Friday, October 23, to visit a friend. Cops say they were told that friend invited over a male acquaintance later in the evening who brought White with him.
      
    
            The Post states the alleged victim told cops White suggested the pair leave the room to give the other two privacy ... and she says they went to a study room in the building.
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                  
      
    
            Once in the study room, officers say the alleged victim told them White pulled out a black pistol and forced her to perform oral sex on him. Cops say she told them White told her to retrieve a paper towel at one point ... but instead she went down to the lobby and told someone to call the cops.
      
    
            White allegedly ran from officers once they arrived ... but cops say they later discovered him hiding under a parked car. They say they found seven grams of marijuana on his person, but no firearm.
      
    
            According to documents reviewed by the New York Post ... White claims the oral sex was consensual, and he never threatened the alleged victim.
      
    
            The Post also reports White was previously arrested after allegedly threatening to shoot a Wendy's employee while on LSU's campus in 2024 ... though the charges were ultimately dropped.

            The FBI is turning up the heat on former Congressman Eric Swalwell ... with federal agents raiding a Beverly Hills mansion as part of their ongoing investigation into sexual misconduct allegations against him.
      
    
            According to Fox News ... FBI agents descended on the ritzy property Tuesday morning, marking the latest twist in the federal probe surrounding the disgraced California Democrat.
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                  
      
    
            It's unclear what agents were looking for at the mansion or whether anything was seized during the search.
      

            As TMZ previously reported ... the FBI confronted Swalwell at San Francisco International Airport in August, seizing his phone and other electronics after serving him with a search warrant.
      
    
            And the feds didn't stop there ... agents also searched his Washington, D.C. home the following day, reportedly gathering additional potential evidence in the investigation.
      
    
            Swalwell has been accused of sexual misconduct by at least five women ... including a former staffer who alleged he raped her while she was too intoxicated to consent.
      
    
        
                    
                  
      
    
            The scandal cost him his political career ... with Swalwell resigning from Congress in April and abandoning his campaign for California governor as the allegations mounted.
      
    
            At the time, Swalwell acknowledged making "mistakes in judgment" ... but fiercely denied the sexual assault allegations, vowing to fight them.
      
    
            Now, with another FBI raid in the books, the investigation appears to be far from over.
